**Marketplace name and URL**


**Why this marketplace?**
Is it dropshipping/scam-prone in the way AliExpress/Temu/Shein are? Roughly
how large is its user base in your region?

**Are you interested in contributing the selector work yourself?**
This is one of the most approachable contributions — see
[CONTRIBUTING.md](../../CONTRIBUTING.md#adding-or-fixing-a-marketplace) and
[docs/SELECTORS.md](../../docs/SELECTORS.md).
- [ ] Yes, I'd like to submit a PR
- [ ] No, just requesting

**Notes on the site's structure (optional)**
If you've looked at the page source, anything you noticed about how product
grids/images are structured (e.g. lazy-loaded, hashed class names, uses
`srcset`) is useful context.
